issues.description: Method calculateTotalPrice(Meal) has conflicting return types between the specification and the solution implementation. The Problem Statement (UML and text) requires calculateTotalPrice to return a double (for "double precision" price calculation). In the solution, SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice is declared as "public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)" (returns int) in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java:57. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected numeric precision and leads to an API that does not match the documented signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the specification by changing the method signature in SealSaloon to return double: "public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)". Compute the sum using a double accumulator (e.g., double sum = 0.0;) and return the double value. Update any call sites that assume an int return (if present) to handle a double. Alternatively, if integer prices are intended, update the problem statement to require an int return and remove the "double precision" wording — but prefer changing the implementation to double to match the documented requirement.
